newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia shares extend bull run, more gains seen.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia shares extend bull run, more gains seen.

text.p: Slovenian shares rose 4.01 percent on Thursday as foreign and domestic investors continued extensive buying of shares of newly privatised companies, and traders predicted the bull run would continue over the week.
* 12 shares rose and five fell, seven were untraded
* Turnover jumps to 799.1 million tolars from 338.2 million
* Drug company Lek's new issue "A" up 6 percent at 21,000
* Bank SKB jumps 12.52 percent to 41,080 on hopes for a London listing
* Construction company GPG down 10 percent at 7,900 -- Novica Mihajlovic, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
